opus.problem: Says Amos 'brought' the LORD's judgment on Damascus, but the verse has him announcing what the LORD says; the LORD is the one who will not revoke judgment. Reword to 'announced' or 'proclaimed'.

Three clues (2, 5, 6) come from the Amaziah episode at Bethel, while Amos's best-known passage, 'let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream' (Amos 5:24), is not used. Replace one Amaziah clue (5 or 6) with it to follow 'known stories first'.
